l: 魔物の死骸か…
A monster's carcass...
These are clean kills.
mamono no shigai ka…
腕はあるようだな
Looks like they've got some skill.
Perhaps young Ember really is ready...
ude haaruyoudana

これでよし
さて ゴーチェに伝えよう

That should do it.
Now, let's go tell Gaute.
Gaute will want to know the stones were delivered. If he's still with us.
koredeyoshi / sate gooche ni tsutae you
さて  布を受け取りに行こう
Now then, let's go get the cloth.
Let's hope the draper has Hortense's cloth.
sate nuno wo uketori ni iko u

…ようやく布が手に入ったな
オルタンスに渡そう

...We finally got the cloth.
Let's take it to Hortense.
That's that done, then. Now it's back to Hortense with her cloth.
… youyaku nuno ga teni itsutsu tana / orutansu ni wataso u
先生  その傭兵をぶっ潰してくだせえ！
Sensei, smash that mercenary to pieces for us!
I'll deal with the bird-lover. You take the handsome one, Killer.
sensei sono youhei wobutsu tsubushi tekudasee!
おうよ  とっちめてやらあ！
You got it, I'll teach 'em a lesson!
Stop calling me that!
ouyo totchimeteyaraa!
…姑息な真似を！
...Underhanded tricks!
Leave now and we can pretend this didn't happen.
… kosoku na mane wo!
グツが来ているはずだ
Goetz should be here.
It shouldn't be too hard to find Goetz.
gutsu ga kite iruhazuda

街外れの倉庫…
あそこか

The warehouse on the outskirts...
Is that it?
Time to brave the viper's nest...
machi hazure no souko… / asokoka

クレシダ廃村…
ハルポクラテスが言っていたのは この辺りだが…

Cressida abandoned village...
Harpocrates said it was around here, but...
Well, it's certainly quiet. If I were a giant antelope, it would seem like just the place...
kureshida haison… / harupokuratesu ga itte itanoha kono atari daga…

こいつがエルダーアンテロープ…！
やるぞ トルガル

This is the Elder Antelope...!
Let's go, Torgal.
I doubt we'll find one bigger than that. You hungry, Torgal?
koitsuga erudaaanteroopu…! / yaruzo torugaru
（トルガルの鳴き声）
(Torgal howls)

<speaker=Torgal>
*bark*
( torugaru no nakigoe)

執事のひとりは この街で報せが途絶えた
見つかるといいが…

We lost word from one of the stewards in this town.
I hope we find him...

It's not going to be easy finding one man in an entire republic.
Let's hope someone here has seen something.
shitsuji nohitoriha kono machi de shirase ga todae ta / mitsu karutoiiga…
奴らは…！？
What are they...?
Someone's got himself in trouble.
yatsu raha…!？

ノースリーチだ
もうひとりの執事を捜そう

Northreach.
Let's look for the other steward.
There's a lot of road between here and the capital. Rutherford's man could be anywhere.
noosuriichi da / mouhitorino shitsuji wo sagaso u
あいつら  ここでも人を…！
Those guys, taking people here too...!
They just couldn't resist, could they?
aitsura kokodemo nin wo…!
何だこいつ  やっちまえ！
What's this guy? Get him!
This one's ours, pretty boy!
nanda koitsu yatchimae!

こんなところか
ラザフォードに報告しよう

Is that everything?
Let's report to Rutherford.
I should go and tell Rutherford that his colleagues are still in one piece.
konnatokoroka / razafoodo ni houkoku shiyou

野生の飛竜草が自生しているのは
この辺りだったな…

Wild dragonleaf usually grows
around here, didn't it...?
Purple flowers blooming next to a waterfall... Shouldn't be too hard to find.
yasei no hiryuu kusa ga jisei shiteirunoha / kono atari dattana…

薄紫の花…
これに違いないだろう

Pale purple flowers...
This has to be it.
Here they are. Might as well pick enough for a bunch, I suppose...
usumurasaki no hana… / koreni chigai naidarou

ヨーテが言っていたのはこの辺り…
早速 ストナ草を探してみよう

Jote said somewhere around here...
Let's start looking for stona grass.
Here's the aqueduct. Now to find our stonawort. Jote mentioned blood-red petals...
yoote ga itte itanohakono atari… / sassoku sutona kusa wo sagashi temiyou
ここにもアカシアか…！
Akashic here too...!
Just my luck...
kokonimo akashia ka…!

ストナ草を探すのは
こいつらを倒してからだ！

If we're going to look for stona grass,
we deal with these first!
Well, I won't be picking anything till they're gone. There's only one thing for it.
sutona kusa wo sagasu noha / koitsurawo taoshi tekarada!

これに違いない
できる限り採っておくとしよう

This has to be it.
Let's gather as much as we can.
Here it is. Better collect as much as I can before reinforcements arrive.
koreni chigai nai / dekiru kagiri totsu teokutoshiyou

こんなところか
隠れ家に戻って ヨーテに渡そう

Is that everything?
Let's head back to the hideaway and give this to Jote.
Alright, that should do it. Let's get these back to Jote.
konnatokoroka / kakure ie ni modotsu te yoote ni wataso u

父上の想い…
“強き心”と“強き絆”か…

Father's wish...
"A strong heart" and "strong bonds"...?
Unwavering will and an unbreakable bond... Do you really think we're strong enough?
chichiue no omoi… / “ tsuyoki kokoro ” to “ tsuyoki kizuna ” ka…

騙し 利用し 陥れる
政は まさに魔窟と言っていい

Deceive, use, betray.
Politics is a den of thieves if ever there was one.

To save the world? Of course. To have overcome Father's political enemies?
Of that, I'm less certain.
damashi riyou shi ochiire ru / matsurigoto ha masani makutsu to itte ii

貴族派の首魁であったお祖父様が
娘である母上に処刑されたほどに
So much so that our grandfather, head of the royalist faction, was executed by our own mother.
Especially knowing what we know now. What Mother was truly capable of...
kizoku ha no shukai deattao sofu sama ga / musume dearu hahaue ni shokei saretahodoni

この腕輪は たしかに父上の想い
祈りなのかもしれない

This bracelet really might be Father's wish.
A prayer, even.

But perhaps these bands would have helped.
Knowing he was with us would have made all the difference.
kono udewa ha tashikani chichiue no omoi / inori nanokamoshirenai
この奥だよ
Through here.
It's just back there.
kono oku dayo
《タイタンの通り道》か
Titan's Wake, is it.
Titan's Wake is to the south of here.
<< taitan no toorimichi >> ka

シムルグというのが どんな魔物か分からない
支度は念入りにしておこう

I don't know what kind of monster a Simurgh is.
Let's make sure we're prepared.
But we must not be hasty. The good lady has been disappointed once already.
shimurugu toiunoga donna mamono ka waka ranai / shitaku ha nen'iri nishiteokou
この辺りか…？
Around here...?
Eyes peeled, Joshua...
kono atari ka…？
こいつか…！
This it...!
There it is!
koitsuka…!
やるぞ  ジョシュア！
Let's go, Joshua!
For House Rosfield!
yaruzo joshua!
これが破魔の緋石…
This is warding ruby...
Is this the heartstone?
korega hama no hi ishi…
ゴディサ卿に届けよう
Let's deliver this to Lady Goditha.
I expect Lady Goditha will know.
godisa kyou ni todoke you

雪月花が咲いているとすれば
この辺りと思うが…

If winter-cherry is in bloom,
I'd think it'd be around here...
The meadows are vast. Where do we even start?
yuki gekka ga sai teirutosureba / kono atari to omou ga…
ヨーテが見た海沿いをあたってみよう
Let's check the coast Jote saw.
Jote mentioned the coastline. We can start there.
yoote ga mita umizoi woatattemiyou
《植物園》の連中に  話を聞いてみよう
Let's ask the folks at the botanical garden.
Let's hope one of the gardeners knows where to find snow daisies.
<< shokubutsuen >> no renchuu ni hanashi wo kii temiyou
兄さん…
Nii-san...
Look, Brother.
niisan…
あの花…！
That flower...!
Do you see them?
ano hana…!

ああ 間違いない
だが まずはこいつらを片づける…！

Yeah, no doubt about it.
But let's clear these out first...!
I do. The flowers and our friends.
aa machigai nai / daga mazuhakoitsurawo katazu keru…!
今度はこいつか！　ジョシュア！
This one next! Joshua!
Let's hope this is the last one.
kondo hakoitsuka! joshua!
ああ行くよ  兄さん！
Right, let's go, nii-san!
Only one way to find out.
aa iku yo niisan!
銀チョコボが近くにいるのは間違いないようだ
There's no mistaking a silver Chocobo is close by.
A silver chocobo sighted in the hills near Rhiannon's Ride...
gin chokobo ga chikaku niirunoha machigai naiyouda

《リアンノン山道》に《廃屋》か…
探してみよう

Rhiannon's Ride and an abandoned house, eh?
Let's search.
It sounds almost too good to be true. But since I'm already here...
<< riannon yamamichi >> ni << haioku >> ka… / sagashi temiyou
銀チョコボのことを聞いてみよう
Let's ask around about the silver Chocobo.
Let's hope one of the merchants here has what Gav needs.
gin chokobo nokotowo kii temiyou

チョコボの足跡がある
しかも新しいな…

Chocobo tracks.
And recent ones, too...
Tracks. And not left by bandits for a change.
chokobo no sokuseki gaaru / shikamo atarashii na…
気配はないが…
No sign of them, though...
I don't hear anything...
kehai hanaiga…

ミドが言っていたのはこれか…
辺りをもう少し探してみよう

Is this what Mid was talking about?
Let's look around a bit more.
Mid's oil. After what happened here, it's a miracle there was any left at all.
mido ga itte itanohakoreka… / atari womou sukoshi sagashi temiyou
これでよし
That's that.
This should be enough.
koredeyoshi

これですべてそろった
ミドのところへ戻ろう

That's everything gathered.
Let's head back to Mid.
I'd better get these materials to Mid so she can finish her prototype.
koredesubetesorotta / mido notokorohe modoro u

よし まずはサロンへ行って
《石の剣》の誰かに聞いてみるか

Right, let's head to the salon first
and ask someone from The Cursebreakers.

I should speak with one of the Cursebreakers before I set off for Auldhyl.
See if I can't find this bone while I'm there as well.
yoshi mazuha saron he itte / << ishi no tsurugi >> no dareka ni kii temiruka
デザートアダマンタスが出るのは  たしかこの辺り――
Desert Adamantoises should be around here...
Here we are again—Corava.
dezaatoadamantasu ga deru noha tashikakono atariii
《ウルドビツァ廃村》付近と言っていたはずだが…
If I recall, they said near the abandoned village of Uld Bidza...
If you were a tortoise, Torgal, where would you hide?
<< urudobitsua haison >> fukin to itte itahazudaga…
あいつがそうか…！
Is that it...!
It looks like we found him!
aitsugasouka…!

…よし 手に入った
これが デザートアダマンタスの甲羅か

...Right, got it.
So this is a Desert Adamantoise shell.
If Mid needs another...she can come and get it herself.
… yoshi teni itsutsu ta / korega dezaatoadamantasu no koura ka
あの頃のままか…
Just like it used to be...
This place hasn't changed at all.
ano gorono mamaka…
秘密の場所があるのは島の中央だ
The secret place is in the middle of the island.
The rookery's right through those trees. Come on.
himitsu no basho gaarunoha shima no chuuou da
この道を  お前とよく競争したな
I used to race you down this path often enough.
Race you there? I bet I can still beat you.
kono michi wo o mae toyoku kyousou shitana
（トルガルの鳴き声）
(Torgal howls)

<speaker=Torgal>
*bark*
( torugaru no nakigoe)
この先だ…
This way...
I think I know where we're going...
kono saki da…

待たせたな
行くとしよう

Kept you waiting.
Let's go.
Sorry for the wait. We're ready.
mata setana / iku toshiyou
戻って  叔父さんに報告しよう
Let's head back and report to Uncle.
My uncle will want to know that his plan is taking shape.
modotsu te oji sanni houkoku shiyou
何の騒ぎだ…？
What's all this racket...?
That can't be Rutherford, can it?
nanno sawagi da…？
ここがガルニック…
So this is Garnick...
The entire village looks abandoned.
kokoga garunikku…
とにかく《外間の書契》を探してみよう
Anyway, let's look for From a Distance.
Now, which house would a bookworm live in...
tonikaku << sotoma no shokei >> wo sagashi temiyou
これは軍の記録…どうしてここに…
Military records... Why are these here...?
This is a royal army log book. Did he take this from the local barracks?
koreha gun no kiroku… doushitekokoni…
こんな書物まであるのか…
They even have books like this...?
His interests were certainly varied...
konna shomotsu madearunoka…
これだ…！
This is it...!
This is it.
koreda…!
よかった  残っていたか
Good, it's still here.
But if what it says is true...
yokatta nokotsu teitaka
この内容が真実なら…
If what's in here is true...
I need to get this back to the hideaway.
kono naiyou ga shinjitsu nara…

ドズメアが目撃されたのは この辺りか？
近くに革職人がいるといいが…

Was a Dozmare sighted around here?
I hope there's a leatherworker nearby...

Griffins don't exactly make for easy prey.
Let's hope our craftsman hasn't bitten off more than he can chew...
dozumea ga mokugeki saretanoha kono atari ka？ / chikaku ni kakushoku nin gairutoiiga…
こいつがドズメアか！
Is this the Dozmare!
The leatherworker will have to wait.
koitsuga dozumea ka!
行くぞ  トルガル…！
Let's go, Torgal...!
Torgal, look sharp!
iku zo torugaru…!

大きな黄色の花…
モーガンビアードに違いない

Large yellow flowers...
It has to be a Morganbeard.
Bright yellow. These are our morganbeards, alright.
ooki na kiiro no hana… / mooganbiaado ni chigai nai

せっかく来たんだ
ある程度の量を摘んでいこう

Since we came all this way,
we might as well pick a fair amount.
Well, I've gone to this much trouble. Might as well gather as many as I can.
sekkaku kita nda / aru teido no ryou wo teki ndeikou
ゴブリン族…それにデカブツか…！
Goblins... and a brute, too...!
The size of a goblin's eye? Not this goblin.
goburin zoku… soreni dekabutsu ka…!
蛮族が好む花に間違いないな
No mistaking it's a flower the beast tribes favor.

He certainly wasn't wrong about them
being attracted to the flowers, though.
banzoku ga konomu hana ni machigai naina

…この花の香りには覚えがある
たしか 子供の頃によく嗅いだ香りだ

...I recognize the scent of this flower.
If I remember right, it's a smell I often caught when I was a boy.
There's something familiar about this scent... It reminds me of home.
… kono hana no kaori niha oboe gaaru / tashika kodomo no goroni yoku kyuu ida kaori da

よし こんなところか
隠れ家へ戻って届けてやるとしよう

Right, that should do it.
Let's head back to the hideaway and deliver it.
Hopefully this will be enough. I've had my fill of goblins.
yoshi konnatokoroka / kakure ie he modotsu te todoke teyarutoshiyou
たしか  この辺りのはずだ
It should be around here, if I remember right.
The marshes near the abbey are certainly damp.
tashika kono atari nohazuda
モーガンビアードを探してみよう
Let's go look for the Morganbeard.
Let's see if they're damp enough for morganbeards.
mooganbiaado wo sagashi temiyou

これがボムの残灰のようだ
もう少し集めておこう

Looks like this is the Bomb's ash.
Let's gather a bit more.
This looks like the stuff. Let's see if there's any more.
korega bomu no zankai noyouda / mou sukoshi atsume teokou
この気配  ただ者じゃない…！
This presence... They're no ordinary foe...!
Look what we have here... Greetings, Your Majesty!
kono kehai tada mono janai…!

これくらいあれば十分だろう
そろそろ隠れ家に戻るか

This should be enough.
Time to head back to the hideaway.
That should do it. If Owain needs more than this, he can fetch it himself.
korekuraiareba juubun darou / sorosoro kakure ie ni modoru ka
…倒したか
...Is it down?
Your reign is over.
… taoshi taka

死に際に灰が残るそうだが…
辺りを探してみよう

They say ash remains upon its death...
Let's look around.
Now to collect the ash. I should probably have brought a bucket...
shini saini hai ga nokoru soudaga… / atari wo sagashi temiyou

イグナーツは ここに滞在してるはずだ
捜してみよう

Ignac should be staying here.
Let's search for him.
People take notice of wealthy men. Shouldn't be too hard to track down Charon's collector.
igunaatsu ha kokoni taizai shiteruhazuda / sagashi temiyou
何だあ  貴様！？
What the hell, you bastard!?
We've got company!
nanda a kisama!？
あの貴族が雇った傭兵か！？
Are you the mercenary that noble hired!?
Come on, lads, let's tear the bastard's head off!
ano kizoku ga yatotsu ta youhei ka!？
これが気根だな  隠れ家へ持ち帰ろう
This is the tendril. Let's take it back to the hideaway.
Well, that was definitely anything but ordinary.
korega kikon dana kakure ie he mochikaero u
それにしても  たしかに強靭なモルボルだった
Still, that certainly was a tough Morbol.
Now let's get this vine back to the yard.
sorenishitemo tashikani kyoujin na moruboru datta

これが例のモルボルか…！
なるほど 並の奴らとは違うようだ！

So this is the Morbol they talked about...
I see, it's not like the usual lot!
It couldn't have been just any morbol, could it? Alright then.
korega reino moruboru ka…! / naruhodo narano yatsu ratoha chigau youda!

…これだな
ブラックソーンに届けよう

...This is it.
Let's deliver it to Blackthorne.
I daresay that will be enough for a decent set of bellows.
… koredana / burakkusoon ni todoke you
あれが  デザートサラマンダーか…
Is that... a desert salamander...?
Let's make this quick, shall we?
arega dezaatosaramandaa ka…

よし これでそろった
隠れ家へ戻ろう

Right, that's all of them.
Let's head back to the hideaway.
That's all of them. Owain can uncross his toes now.
yoshi koredesorotta / kakure ie he modoro u

…これだな
ほかの遺跡も調べてみるとしよう

...This is it.
Let's check the other ruins, too.
This is it. Right then, just two more to find.
… koredana / hokano iseki mo shirabe temirutoshiyou
…これでふたつ  次で最後か
...That's two. One left after this?
Two down, one to go.
… koredefutatsu tsugi de saigo ka
まずはこいつらを叩く！
First, we strike these ones!
I'll need to deal with these ones first...
mazuhakoitsurawo tataku!
さて  《球体遺物》を探そう
Now then, let's find the orb relic.
Now to find this spherical echo...
sate << kyuutai ibutsu >> wo sagaso u

オーガストが来てるはずだ
早く合流しよう

August should be here.
Let's hurry and meet up with him.
So, Dravozd is still standing. For now, at least.
oogasuto ga kite ruhazuda / hayaku gouryuu shiyou
来い  俺が相手だ！
Come on, I'll take you on!
You're not getting past me.
koi ore ga aite da!
《ロザリアの心》…どんなチョコボなんだ…？
The Heart of Rosaria... What kind of Chocobo is it...?
"Whiteheart"? That's quite a name for a chocobo.
<< rozaria no kokoro >>… donna chokobo nanda…？
これは  チョコボを追ってた野盗か…？
Could these be the bandits who were chasing the Chocobo...?
These chocobos aren't going down without a fight.
koreha chokobo wo otsu teta yatou ka…？
（トルガルの鳴き声）
(Torgal howls)

<speaker=Torgal>
*barks*
( torugaru no nakigoe)
あれは…！
That's...!
They're in trouble!
areha…!

…温かい料理か
久しく口にしてなかったな

...A hot meal.
I haven't had one of those in a long time.
A hot meal... How long has it been?
… atatakai ryouri ka / hisashiku kuchi nishitenakattana

すべて運んだな
ケネスのところへ戻ろう

Brought everything over.
Let's head back to Kenneth.
That's the last one. I'd better let Kenneth know.
subete hakon dana / kenesu notokorohe modoro u

…これだな
さて あの大工のところへ持っていこう

...This is it.
Now, let's take this to that carpenter.
Here we are. I'd better get this to...Geoffroy, was it?
… koredana / sate ano daiku notokorohe motsu teikou

パンとワインか…
さっきのベアラーたちに持っていってやろう

Bread and wine...
Let's go take these to those Bearers from earlier.
Bread and wine... Hopefully this will be enough.
pan to wain ka… / sakkino bearaa tachini motsu teitteyarou

この辺りか
さて 魔物を駆除しよう

Is this the area?
Right, time to cull the fiends.

That must be the vineyard. A few wasps
shouldn't give me too much trouble.
kono atari ka / sate mamono wo kujo shiyou

…全部倒したな
ロストウィングに戻って伝えてやるか

...Got every last one.
Time to head back to Lostwing and let them know.

Looks like that was the last of them.
I'd better let Quinten's man know.
… zenbu taoshi tana / rosutouingu ni modotsu te tsutae teyaruka

これですべて届けたな
ケネスに報告しよう

That's everything delivered.
I should report back to Kenneth.
I think that's everyone. I'd better let Kenneth know.
koredesubete todoke tana / kenesu ni houkoku shiyou
きゃぁぁぁぁ！
Aaaaaah!
*scream*
kyaaaaa!
今の悲鳴は…！？
That scream...!
Someone's in trouble!
ima no himei ha…!？

早速 土を採取するか
何か所か回って集めるとしよう

Time to gather some soil.
I'll need to check a few spots to collect enough.

Soil, then. There's certainly enough of it here.
But is it dark, rich, and fragrant?
sassoku tsuchi wo saishu suruka / nankasho ka mawatsu te atsume rutoshiyou

これくらいあれば十分か…
隠れ家へ戻ろう

This should be enough...
Let's head back to the hideaway.
This should be enough. I'd better get it back to the hideaway.
korekuraiareba juubun ka… / kakure ie he modoro u

彼が時間を稼いでいる間に
ノリスを見つけないと
